As Director Finance, I helped turn collective effort into practical support. The spreadsheets mattered because of what happened after them.

this part means a lot.
347ration bags+

A Ramadan campaign with a tangible outcome.

Helped raise and managed over PKR 1.6 million to purchase 347 ration bags during Ramadan 2025.

2,200+clothing articles · three days+

Led eight teams in a clothing drive that collected over 2,200 items in three days and distributed them to more than 150 households.

100k+PKR raised for earthquake relief+

Led a month-long fundraising campaign supporting earthquake victims in Türkiye and Syria.

and a lot of people behind the scenes.Orientations, societies, and student teams+

Worked with five teams to arrange an orientation for 200+ club members. Across university, I took on roles from executive to treasurer in more than five societies and events, including ASHRAE and Islamabad SolidWorks User Group, at times managing over 80 people.
